integrity: New analytic identities and sharp parameter classification supported by a standalone exact-symbolic verifier; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic real scalar affine-time damping on one unit step; no conclusion for arbitrary nonlinear/nonautonomous systems. Gauss contractivity and A-stability background are classical. Equivalent earlier specific-tableau calculations remain an originality risk.
title: A sharp nonautonomous contractivity barrier for the A-stable four-stage nIRK4 method
